# Milestone 3 — Hypothesis Agent Results

**Date:** 2026-04-08  
**Solver accuracy:** 20 / 1000 tasks (2.0%)  
**Avg partial score:** 48.0%  
**Runtime:** ~54s for full training set

---

## Architecture


The Milestone 3 solver chains five components:

```
Task
 ├── perceive(task)       → PerceptionReport  (objects, colors, symmetry, lines, topology, periodicity)
 ├── classify(task)       → DifferentialReport (cross-pair feature confidence: RELEVANT / INCIDENTAL / AMBIGUOUS)
 │
 ├── global_color_map.py  → if color_mapping RELEVANT → apply globally
 ├── object_recolor.py    → if color_mapping RELEVANT → try 7 selection predicates
 ├── object_move.py       → if movement_vector/direction RELEVANT → offset or gravity
 ├── pattern_fill.py      → pixel zoom, tile, flood fill
 └── mirror.py            → 8 flip/rotation/concat operations (always generated)
     │
     └── executor.py      → score each hypothesis on all training pairs
         │
         └── solver.py    → pick the simplest passing hypothesis (MDL)
                            if none pass: return best two by avg score
```

**Files created:**
- `hypotheses/base.py` — `Hypothesis` dataclass (name, apply, complexity)
- `hypotheses/global_color_map.py`
- `hypotheses/object_recolor.py`
- `hypotheses/object_move.py`
- `hypotheses/pattern_fill.py`
- `hypotheses/mirror.py`
- `executor.py` — `execute(hypothesis, train_pairs) → ExecutionResult`
- `solver.py` — updated main solver

## Why Only 2%?



**Task distribution** (first 400 tasks analysed):
- 31% of tasks change the output shape → our hypotheses mostly handle same-shape cases
- 35% have a consistent `move` transform → our `move_offset` only fires when a single exact vector is invariant; most move tasks are more nuanced (move selected objects, gravity toward another object, etc.)
- 14% have a consistent `recolor` transform → we generate 7 predicates but many tasks recolor based on complex spatial conditions we don't yet encode

**Root causes of near-misses:**
1. `recolor_enclosed` scores 96% — the enclosure BFS misses edge cases where the "wall" is not perfectly sealed from every direction
2. `global_color_map` scores 98% on some tasks — those tasks change only a subset of cells of the target color (not all of them), so a global remap gets the non-selected ones wrong
3. Many movement tasks move only objects of a specific color, not all objects — `move_offset` moves everything

**Milestone 4 targets:**
- Object-move with color filter (move only objects matching a predicate)
- Symmetry completion (half-grid input → fill the other half by reflection)
- Object-stamp (copy a small template to all positions marked by a specific color)
- Better enclosure detection (handle partial walls / L-shapes)
